paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training set.
model_annotation: The figure consists of two line plots displaying training rewards over steps for two different training sets, Easy and Hard. The plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps", with a linear scale, a range of 0 to 500, and tick labels at regular intervals of 100; no units are specified. For both plots, the y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards", with a linear scale and a range of 0.0 to 0.4 for the Easy Training Set plot and 0.0 to 0.2 for the Hard Training Set plot; tick labels are not numbered but appear to be at intervals of 0.1 and 0.05 respectively. The Easy Training Set plot shows two lines: one for Llama-On-Policy-Easy, which starts at approximately 0.04 and increases to around 0.35, represented by a green solid line with circle markers; and one for Llama-LUFFY-Easy, which starts at around 0.02 and increases to approximately 0.38, represented by a red solid line with circle markers. The shaded areas around each line likely represent variability or confidence intervals but are not explicitly described. The Hard Training Set plot also displays two lines: Llama-On-Policy-Hard, a green line with a dashed style and circle markers, begins at about 0.04 then declines to nearly 0, and Llama-LUFFY-Hard, a red solid line with circle markers, increases from nearly 0 to around 0.16; again, shaded areas are present around each line.
